title: The Four-Year Cycle Debate
request: why people say bitcoin's four-year cycle is dead
story: After the 2024 halving and the arrival of spot ETFs, a growing number of crypto analysts and channels argue bitcoin no longer follows the roughly four-year boom-and-bust rhythm tied to halvings. Others say the cycle is intact and just stretched or muted. The dispute has sharpened each time price action diverged from the old halving-based roadmap.
central_claim: Bitcoin's four-year halving cycle no longer governs its price, so the pattern of a post-halving peak followed by a deep bear market will not repeat.
not_about: Not about whether bitcoin is a good investment, not about specific price targets, not about the mechanics of the halving or mining economics, and not about other crypto assets.
